title: 特朗普批伦敦市长是“恐怖秀” 称其无能且糟糕
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's very liberal, but, you know, I got along well with Stomer and disagreed with Stomer.
segments.zh: 虽然伦敦很自由，但我跟斯托默相处得不错，也有分歧。

segments.en: I said, you have two problems, immigration and energy and crime, too, by the way, crime.
segments.zh: 我说，你们有两个问题：移民和能源，还有犯罪。

segments.en: You have a terrible mayor of London, by the way. I don't want to cause any problems, but your mayor of London is grossly incompetent, a bad person, and a horrible representative for your country.
segments.zh: 你们的伦敦市长糟糕透顶，无能、人品差，是国家的糟糕代表。

segments.en: You know that. That's why you're smiling and laughing and it's true, brother.
segments.zh: 你知道的，所以你笑了，这是事实，兄弟。

segments.en: You know that. The mayor of London is a horror show, but you have a crime problem, you have an immigration problem, and the immigration helps cause the crime, by the way, and you have a tremendous
segments.zh: 伦敦市长是个灾难，你们有犯罪、移民问题，移民助长了犯罪，还有严重的能源问题。

segments.en: energy problem. You're building stupid windmills all over the country, and they don't do the job.
segments.zh: 你们在全国建愚蠢的风车，但根本没用。

segments.en: You have the greatest oil field in the world, one of them.
segments.zh: 你们拥有世界最大的油田之一。

segments.en: It's called the North Sea Oil. All you have to do is bid it out to Exxon, Chevron, Shell, British petroleum.
segments.zh: 就是北海油田，只需招标给埃克森、雪佛龙、壳牌、英国石油。

segments.en: They're begging to go there and pay billions of dollars.
segments.zh: 他们求着去那里，支付数十亿美元。

segments.en: And because the left is so crazy, they don't want the money.
segments.zh: 但因为左派太疯狂，他们不想要这笔钱。

segments.en: And the country is losing, I mean, it's going to go, your country is going to go bankrupt.
segments.zh: 这个国家正在衰落，我的意思是，它要破产了，你的国家要破产了。

segments.en: Think of it. Now, most countries don't have that.
segments.zh: 想想看。现在，大多数国家没有这个。

segments.en: You have the North Sea Oil, and you have the best part of it.
segments.zh: 你们有北海石油，而且你们拥有最好的部分。
